001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.disruptor;
002
003import java.util.Collection;
004import java.util.List;
005import java.util.concurrent.ThreadFactory;
006
007import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
008
009import com.lmax.disruptor.BlockingWaitStrategy;
010import com.lmax.disruptor.EventHandler;
011import com.lmax.disruptor.ExceptionHandler;
012import com.lmax.disruptor.RingBuffer;
013import com.lmax.disruptor.dsl.Disruptor;
014import com.lmax.disruptor.dsl.ProducerType;
015import com.lmax.disruptor.util.DaemonThreadFactory;
016
017import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogAlerts;
018import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogAppender;
019import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogConfig;
020import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEvent;
021import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogPublisher;
022import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogPublisher.AsyncLogPublisher;
023import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogAppender.Appenders;
024
025/**
026 * Disruptor async publisher.
027 */
028public final class DisruptorLogPublisher implements AsyncLogPublisher {
029
030        private final Disruptor<LogEventCell> disruptor;
031
032        private final RingBuffer<LogEventCell> ringBuffer;
033
034        private final Iterable<? extends LogAppender> appenders;
035
036        private final LogAlerts alerts;
037
038        /**
039         * Creates a factory of disruptor log publishers.
040         * @param bufferSize ring buffer size.
041         * @return factory to generate this class.
042         */
043        public static PublisherFactory of(int bufferSize) {
044                return new PublisherFactory() {
045                        @Override
046                        public LogPublisher create(String name, LogConfig config, Appenders appenders) {
047                                return of(appenders.asList(), DaemonThreadFactory.INSTANCE, bufferSize, config.alerts());
048                        }
049                };
050        }
051
052        /**
053         * Creates.
054         * @param appenders appenders.
055         * @param threadFactory thread factory to create writer thread.
056         * @param bufferSize maximum queue elements.
057         * @param alerts alerts for reporting internal errors (disruptor exception handler
058         * failures).
059         * @return publisher.
060         */
061        public static DisruptorLogPublisher of(Collection<? extends LogAppender> appenders, ThreadFactory threadFactory,
062                        int bufferSize, LogAlerts alerts) {
063
064                Disruptor<LogEventCell> disruptor = new Disruptor<>(LogEventCell::new, bufferSize, threadFactory,
065                                ProducerType.MULTI, new BlockingWaitStrategy());
066                var router = new DisruptorLogPublisher(disruptor, disruptor.getRingBuffer(), List.copyOf(appenders), alerts);
067                disruptor.setDefaultExceptionHandler(new LogExceptionHandler(disruptor::shutdown, router));
068
069                boolean found = false;
070                for (var appender : appenders) {
071                        disruptor.handleEventsWith(new LogEventHandler(appender));
072                        found = true;
073                }
074                if (!found) {
075                        throw new IllegalStateException();
076                }
077
078                return router;
079        }
080
081        @Override
082        public void start(LogConfig config) {
083                disruptor.start();
084        }
085
086        DisruptorLogPublisher(Disruptor<LogEventCell> disruptor, RingBuffer<LogEventCell> ringBuffer,
087                        Iterable<? extends LogAppender> appenders, LogAlerts alerts) {
088                super();
089                this.disruptor = disruptor;
090                this.ringBuffer = ringBuffer;
091                this.appenders = appenders;
092                this.alerts = alerts;
093        }
094
095        @Override
096        public void log(LogEvent event) {
097                long sequence = ringBuffer.next();
098                try {
099                        LogEventCell cell = ringBuffer.get(sequence);
100                        cell.event = event;
101                }
102                finally {
103                        ringBuffer.publish(sequence);
104                }
105
106        }
107
108        @Override
109        public void close() {
110                this.disruptor.halt();
111        }
112
113        @Override
114        public String toString() {
115                return super.toString() + "[appenders=" + this.appenders + "]";
116        }
117
118        private static class LogEventCell {
119
120                @Nullable LogEvent event;
121
122        }
123
124        private static record LogEventHandler(LogAppender appender) implements EventHandler<LogEventCell> {
125
126                @Override
127                public void onEvent(LogEventCell event, long sequence, boolean endOfBatch) throws Exception {
128                        var logEvent = event.event;
129                        if (logEvent == null) {
130                                return;
131                        }
132                        appender.append(logEvent);
133                }
134
135        }
136
137        private record LogExceptionHandler(Runnable shutdownHook,
138                        DisruptorLogPublisher publisher) implements ExceptionHandler<Object> {
139
140                @Override
141                public void handleEventException(Throwable ex, long sequence, Object event) {
142                        if (ex instanceof InterruptedException) {
143                                shutdownHook.run();
144                        }
145                        else {
146                                publisher.alerts.error(DisruptorLogPublisher.class, ex);
147                                throw new RuntimeException(ex);
148                        }
149                }
150
151                @Override
152                public void handleOnStartException(Throwable ex) {
153                        publisher.alerts.error(DisruptorLogPublisher.class, ex);
154                }
155
156                @Override
157                public void handleOnShutdownException(Throwable ex) {
158                        publisher.alerts.error(DisruptorLogPublisher.class, ex);
159                }
160
161        }
162
163}
